decision_policy.primary_rule: Prefer the largest unit that preserves a complete epistolary or rhetorical operation without absorbing the next operation.

macro_parents.function: Prescript, astonished rebuke, doubled anathema, and servant test.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Gal.1.5/Gal.1.6 is sharp, while Gal.1.1-10 remains the opening-rebuke parent.

macro_parents.function: Autobiographical source defense, consultations, recognition, Antioch confrontation, and speech.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Temporal notices structure the narrated defense but authorize no chronology or harmonization.

macro_parents.function: Hearing-faith questions, Abraham proof, curse/redemption, promise-law reasoning, heir/adoption analogy, and return warning.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Gal.3.29/Gal.4.1 is subordinate to the heir analogy through Gal.4.7.

macro_parents.function: Personal appeal and remembered reception followed by Hagar-Sarah allegory, citation, and application.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Gal.5.1 may close the allegory or open the next warning; both routes remain held.

macro_parents.function: Freedom warning, love summary, flesh-Spirit lists, restoration, burdens, sowing-reaping, and doing-good paraenesis.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Lists and imperatives remain bound to their frames and carry no authority.

macro_parents.function: Autograph, circumcision-boasting contrast, rule, marks, and benediction.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The autograph marker begins one integrated close.

units.working_title: Prescript, deliverance expansion, and doxology
units.literary_rationale: The salutation expands into one purpose-bearing clause and resolves before the astonished rebuke.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: A split erases the expanded prescript shape.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Merging Gal.1.6 suppresses the rhetorical turn.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: The greeting is not theological boundary authority.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve every exact route, and defer to a human or external AI specialist.

units.working_title: Astonished rebuke, doubled anathema, and servant test

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Extracting a curse creates an isolated maxim.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No opponent or discipline policy is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve every exact route, and defer to a human or external AI specialist.

global_premortems.detection: A seam follows a chapter number without a discourse turn.
A rationale claims event identity, harmonization, opponents, or chronology.
global_premortems.mitigation: Describe narrated sequence only as rhetorical evidence.

global_premortems.detection: Gal.2.14/2.15 punctuation is claimed as certain.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain Gal.2.11-21 LOW and preserve exact alternatives.

global_premortems.detection: A citation becomes a standalone proof text.
global_premortems.mitigation: Bind citation to question, proof, and inference.

global_premortems.detection: Gal.3.29/4.1 is split solely by chapter.

global_premortems.mitigation: Retain setup, mapping, citation, and application.
Retain vocation, love citation, and warning.

global_premortems.detection: Commands are converted into institutional rules.
Autograph, contrast, rule, marks, or blessing is isolated.
Literary labels select text, speaker, doctrine, history, or practice.
